minor.issue: Observed one intermittent 500 'AttributeError: list object has no attribute get' at server.py:500 — happens when LLM returns gen['experiences'] containing a non-dict item. Retrying generate succeeded immediately. Pre-existing LLM-robustness gap, not caused by this remediation. Suggest: filter non-dict entries: `{e['node_id']: e for e in gen.get('experiences',[]) if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get('node_id')}`.
